project_comments.message: QA validation completed. 5 work packages PASSED (WP-001, WP-002, WP-003, WP-004, WP-006), 2 work packages FAILED (WP-005, WP-007). Total 8 TypeScript compilation errors blocking frontend build. Backend passes all checks. Failures are localized to unused parameter warnings and optional type narrowing issues. Detailed bug reports added to failed WP ledgers.

Fixed all 8 TypeScript compilation errors. WP-005: Prefixed unused shipSize parameters with underscore (_shipSize) in metricContext.ts to satisfy noUnusedParameters rule. WP-007: Replaced strict null checks (!== null) with loose null checks (!= null) in EnginePerformanceDisplay.tsx to properly narrow both null and undefined. TypeScript compilation now passes cleanly (npx tsc --noEmit). Both work packages updated to COMPLETE status with qa-fix pipeline entries.

QA re-verification PASSED. All developer fixes confirmed working. WP-005 and WP-007 both pass TypeScript strict mode compilation. Total compilation errors: 0. All 7 implementation work packages (WP-001 through WP-007) now COMPLETE and validated. Ready to proceed to documentation phase (WP-008).

Code review COMPLETE for all 7 implementation work packages (WP-001 through WP-007). All work packages PASSED with scores: maintainability 8.0-9.5/10, best practices 8.5-9.5/10, security 10/10, performance 8.0-10/10. Zero blocking issues found. Implementation quality is excellent with strong adherence to PHP 8.4 strict types, TypeScript strict mode, proper readonly enforcement, clean separation of concerns, and comprehensive error handling. Gold nuggets identified for future optimization (method extraction, DRY improvements, timeout configuration). All acceptance criteria met. Ready for documentation phase (WP-008).

Documentation phase COMPLETE for WP-008. Updated 6 manifest documents: public-api.md (added ClassRangeService, 4 new DTOs, classRangeApi, useClassRange hook, updated existing DTOs with readonly and new fields), file-tree.md (added 11 new files across backend/frontend), data-flows.md (added comprehensive Class-Wide Range Calculation Flow with timeline and comparison), tech-stack.md (documented Class-Wide Aggregation Pattern as pattern #9), constraints.md (updated debounce table with 300ms vs 500ms values), API.md (added POST /api/calculate/class-range endpoint docs with examples). All version numbers incremented to 1.1. All 'Last Updated' dates refreshed to February 15, 2026. All 7 acceptance criteria met. No contradictions between manifest and code. Project COMPLETE - all 8 work packages finished successfully.
